title: Embedding: Types, interface, registries, catalog, BatchEmbed, entry point
description:
Implement embedding API core from docs/plans/01-ai-core.add01.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §4 (types), §5 (interface + registries), §7 (catalog), §5.4 (BatchEmbed), §5.3 (Embed entry point), §9 (public re-exports)

Key deliverables:
- Types: EmbeddingRequest, EmbeddingResponse, Embedding, EmbeddingUsage, EmbeddingTaskType (6 constants), EmbeddingEncoding (6 constants), EmbeddingModel, EmbeddingCost, EmbedFunc
- EmbeddingProvider interface (API() + Embed())
- Provider registry: RegisterEmbeddingProvider, GetEmbeddingProvider, UnregisterEmbeddingProviders, ClearEmbeddingProviders (sync.RWMutex, isolated from chat registry)
- Model registry: RegisterEmbeddingModel, GetEmbeddingModel, ListEmbeddingModels, ListEmbeddingModelsByProvider, ClearEmbeddingModels
- embedding_catalog.json with 4 models (text-embedding-3-small, text-embedding-3-large, gemini-embedding-001, embed-v4.0), go:embed loading
- BatchEmbed utility: batch splitting by MaxBatchSize, index ordering, progress callback, partial results on error. Uses EmbedFunc parameter (NOT provider.Embed — seam review P1 fix)
- Embed() entry point: validate request, lookup model+provider, check dimension bounds, calculate cost, preserve ProviderError
- Public re-export layer: ai/embedding.go
- Unit tests for all of the above

File layout: internal/ai/embedding.go, embedding_provider.go, embedding_registry.go, embedding_models.go, embedding_batch.go, embedding_api.go, ai/embedding.go

Seam notes: EmbeddingProvider uses separate struct per provider (not shared with chat Provider — API() collision fix). BatchEmbed takes EmbedFunc not provider.Embed (recursion fix).
